blogs.title: Beyond Ludwig’s Angina – When Neck Swelling Misleads ENT Surgeons
blogs.description: "This post walks through how soft tissue oedema in the strap muscles can masquerade as a deep neck infection yet stem from an autoimmune process such as dermatomyositis. It explains key clinical clues that prompt ordering creatine kinase early rather than immediately treating presumed infection."

blogs.title: Nailfold Capillaroscopy & Subtle Skin Signs – Early Red Flags for Dermatomyositis
blogs.description: "Examine how micro haemorrhages and periungual erythema detected on a quick capillaroscopied nail fold can trigger concern for an inflammatory myopathy when classic rash is absent—illustrating an underused bedside tool that saved time in our patient's journey."

blogs.title: "Anti‑SAE1 Antibody‑Positive Dermatomyositis – Clinical Features & Why It Matters"
blogs.description: "Delve into what the SAE1 autoantibody represents biologically, its usual cutaneous manifestations such as helicotrope eruption or shawl sign—and why this subtype has higher rates of dysphagia, interstitial lung disease and even malignant associations compared with other myositis antibodies."

blogs.title: "Imaging Myositis Across Modalities – From CT Neck Edema To FDG‑PET Surveillance"
blogs.description: "Review how contrast CT can reveal diffuse cervical oedema without abscess formation; MRI demonstrates perifascicular inflammation consistent with dermatomyositis; FDG-PET maps active muscle uptake while simultaneously offering oncologic staging—a combined armamentarium that guided our therapeutic plan."

blogs.title: "Therapeutic Roadmap for Severe Dermatomyositis With Airway Involvement"
blogs.description: "Outline an evidence‑based strategy starting with pulse methylprednisolone followed by steroid tapering, intravenous immunoglobulin infusions and second-line agents such as mycophenolate mofetil and rituximab—all while navigating infection prophylaxis choices and monitoring response via serial creatine kinase levels."
